judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant, well-structured sky with layered cirrus and a low cumulus line, but the flat daylight keeps it from being especially striking.
strengths: expansive sky with layered wispy cloud bands
distinct lower line of puffy clouds
weaknesses: ordinary daylight with little dramatic light
